artifacts.summary: Validation-1 PASSED at 17a4ff133f24 (base 7e0f9c242e64): the five rules are each placed once where their reader loads them; the First Officer reads 34 more words and the workflow text 86 more, as amendment 2 accepts; the raise step quotes only the Captain. Independent fresh readers confirmed that the base lacks the stop question, the not-proposed commit loses the kept-results answer, and the candidate has both; controls do not trigger. Merged by fast-forward at the validated commit. After the merge the clean host's clone was fast-forwarded and a fresh worker started there through Paseo loaded the package from the marketplace folder that points at the clone and saw the new text; the two documented update commands reported nothing to update and left the plugin cache copy at the old text, differing in the five changed files. Known limits, not fixed: the three worth answers at a budget hold appear in no arm because they exist only in script output; readers were single runs per scenario on a smaller model and an older Claude Code, with only the lost-and-restored scenario repeated; no reader read the implementation or validation worker text; the word lint counts the workflow text alone; minutes to the first report and whether a message carried minutes stay not recorded; the prepared PR text still says the worker scenarios were not run on the candidate, which validation did run. Time: about 105 of 120 minutes at the merge, 34 of them waiting on a person; the host step ran past the box by the reform session's ruling. Follow-up listed, not done: the validation text should say acceptance scripts take paths as arguments or write the home directory as a tilde.
